name: Dean Sharp
source: Dean Sharp is a construct in the style of Frankenstein's wife. Dean Sharp is motivated by the desire to make Silverleaf College a place of excellence for the education and personal growth of supernatural creatures. She possesses great intelligence and extensive knowledge in various academic fields.
